project: Quran Forced Alignment - Model C Tokenization Failure
reason: Direct alignment with standard Quran script is impossible. Model C utilizes a custom Latin transliterated phonetic vocabulary ('word_tr' field in training dataset Buraaq/quran-md-words). Standard Arabic or Uthmani scripture cannot be tokenized by the model and yields [UNK] for all letters, leading to total trellis blockage.
g2p_requirement: To execute alignment, a highly complex Grapheme-to-Phoneme (G2P) conversion model is required to convert Uthmani text into exactly matching Latin phonemes. No such G2P model is currently shipped with this model.
